newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to aim for the 4,900 region.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to aim for the 4,900 region.

text.p: UK stock market bulls will take their revenge on Wednesday by sending the FTSE 100 index up to 4,900 and chasing off the bears, technical analysts said.

The bears had lost control on Monday when they failed to drag the index below the 4,800 level, and with Wall Street making an about-turn and becoming bullish once more, buyers of the UK market will regain the initiative, they added.
The FTSE should regain its place above its 10 day moving average opening the chance to plot a course to higher levels.
By 0715 GMT, the index was indicated up 38.0 points to 4,884.7.
A remarkable surge by the Dow Jones industrials on Tuesday -- it finished up 154.93 points to 8,061.65 -- should put the heart back into the UK market which had started the week on a glum note.
There is now the opportunity another stab at the psychologically important 5,000 level for the FTSE over the near-term, analysts said.
It twice failed to go above that level on an intra-day basis last week but if the Dow maintains its robust form, the FTSE is bound to follow suit, they added.
